reason: Both answers correctly recommend against full event sourcing, in favor of CRUD plus an append-only double-entry ledger and an idempotent usage log, and both point to Stripe Billing, Orb, Metronome or Lago. A adds concrete design detail (invoice pricing snapshots, a subscription history table) and the GDPR point, and states the pattern-enthusiasm red flag directly. B leads with buy vs. build, quantifies the cost and scope (proration, dunning, tax, rev rec, 6–12+ months), and makes the ACID argument. The strengths balance out.
